summary.zh: 收录玩家自己的 MDT 路线，逐波整理计划和标记，并在副本中通过 HUD、声音与语音展示。
summary.en: Collect your own MDT routes, annotate pull plans and markers, and display them through an in-dungeon HUD with audio reminders.

zh: 从玩家安装的 MDT 收录路线快照
逐波计划、备注与标记安排
波次 HUD 与语音播报
玩家触发的计划分享与标记宏
en: Route snapshots from the player's MDT installation
Pull plans, notes, and marker assignments
Player-triggered plan sharing and marking macros
